name: mirage
text:
Diagnosis: the engine is reading Novig through the slow public route (0.3 prices a second; the last scan took 11 minutes) because Novig rejects the engine's read key: 'the key ID and the key file are not from the same key'. The address is fine (not refused), and nothing else is wrong. So the key ID and key file stored on GitHub are a mismatched pair, probably from an earlier send that only updated one of them.
What to do, in this order, in the app:
1. Make the new Novig key and finish creating it.
2. Settings > Cloud scan > 'Send a Novig read-only key' (it makes a new read-only key and sends the ID and file together). Wait for it to say sent.
3. Tell me here 'sent'. I'll restart the engine on a fresh runner so it reads the new pair right away.
I can't create or send the key myself. If you'd rather not wait for me, pulling to refresh after the send also asks the engine to rescan.
